relevance.rationale: Proves exact topological equivalence (up to smooth non-vanishing rescaling and Riemannian metric) between contact Reeb vector fields and non-singular rotational Beltrami steady Euler flows on 3-manifolds.

keyResults.statement: Any non-singular rotational Beltrami field on a Riemannian 3-manifold is a Reeb-like field for some contact 1-form, and conversely every contact Reeb field solves steady incompressible Euler for a compatible metric.
keyResults.useForFolio: Direct literature foundation for prop:reeb-beltrami-regular-flow on UT(Sigma_4) (QOU.FluidDynamics.BeltramiSteadyEuler).
